hookLine: Ranking the most chaotic live TV news fails from 5 to 1!

items.voiceLine: Number 5: A kid casually crashing dad's live BBC interview.
Number 4: The reporter's giant chicken flapping right into his face.
Number 3: The reporter completely zoning out the second the camera cuts to her.
Number 2: A stray stop sign flying straight into the reporter's face during a storm.
Number 1: The anchor collapsing live on air, right in the middle of the broadcast!
